The Gasoline engine factory is a facility that creates 1x gasoline engine every 4 minutes and 20 seconds.

It costs 105/52 Steel mills and 12/13 Rubber factories to sustain this.

To sustain the entire process, you need 105/52 Steel mills, 107/364 Coal mines, 35/26 Iron mines,12/65 Oil wells, and 12/13 Rubber factories.
